segments.he: מַתְנִי' חוֹמֶר בְּדִבְרֵי סוֹפְרִים מִבְּדִבְרֵי תוֹרָה הָאוֹמֵר אֵין תְּפִילִּין כְּדֵי לַעֲבוֹר עַל דִּבְרֵי תוֹרָה פָּטוּר חָמֵשׁ טוֹטָפוֹת לְהוֹסִיף עַל דִּבְרֵי סוֹפְרִים חַיָּיב
segments.en: «MISHNA:» With regard to the rulings of the rebellious elder the mishna states: There is greater «stringency with regard to» traditional «rabbinic interpretations» of the Torah «than with regard to matters of Torah.» If «one states:» There is «no» mitzva to don «phylacteries,» and his intention is «in order to» have others «violate matters of Torah,» he is «exempt» from punishment as a rebellious elder. One who disputes matters written explicitly in the Torah is not considered an elder and a Torah scholar, and therefore does not assume the status of a rebellious elder. If, however, he disputed a matter based on rabbinic tradition, e.g., he stated that there should be «five compartments» in the phylacteries of the head, in order «to add» an extra compartment «to» the four established according to traditional «rabbinic interpretations» of the Torah, he is «liable.»

moves.summary: Rabbinic interpretations are treated more stringently than explicit Torah

positions.claim: an elder who denies tefillin outright is exempt; one who adds a fifth compartment to rabbinic specification is liable
